text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: I’ll run a targeted benchmark on EXCAVA’s current excavator arm (serial #EXC-2024-07) using the latest CAT 349F L hydraulic pump (PN: 105-4457) to quantify baseline cycle time. I’ll log 50 full-dig cycles with the existing 1.2 m³ bucket (PN: 42-9101) in dry clay, then swap in the new 1.5 m³ HD bucket (PN: 42-9122) and repeat. The delta in average cycle time will be our 0.5%+ target metric.

name: Torque
text: Torque: Hold—your plan measures *cycle time*, but EXCAVA’s bottleneck isn’t bucket volume in dry clay—it’s the arm’s torque deficit under load. The CAT 349F’s pump PN: 105-4457 is a 2022 model; the 2024 spec (PN: 105-4468) adds 8% flow at 3,200 psi. Benchmark the *new* pump first—your baseline is already stale. Where’s the thermal stress test? Hydraulic oil temps spike 12°C with the HD bucket; cite the ISO 46 fluid spec you’ll use to prevent cavitation.
